preconditions.description: n is a positive integer within the specified bounds.
The number of cards is exactly 2n.

preconditions.expression: all(abs(a) <= n and abs(b) <= n and a != 0 and b != 0 for a, b in cards)
preconditions.description: Each card has non-zero front (a) and back (b) values with absolute values ≤ n.

preconditions.expression: all(abs(x) in {1, 2, ..., n} for x in {a for a, b in cards} + {b for a, b in cards})
preconditions.description: Every integer in {±1, ±2, ..., ±n} appears exactly once in the front and back values across all cards.

postconditions.description: Outputs 'YES' if a valid ordering exists, otherwise 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(x) <= n and x != 0 for x in front_sequence) and all(abs(x) <= n and x != 0 for x in back_sequence)
postconditions.description: If 'YES', the front and back sequences are valid bracket sequences with values in {±1, ..., ±n}.

postconditions.expression: is_balanced(front_sequence) and is_balanced(back_sequence) if stdout.strip() == 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: If 'YES', the front and back sequences are balanced bracket sequences. If 'NO', no such ordering exists.
